newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philodrill nine-mth net at 112.66 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Philodrill nine-mth net at 112.66 mln pesos.

text.p: Philippine oil explorer Philodrill Corp said on Monday it posted an unaudited net income of 112.66 million pesos for the first nine months of the year.
For the first half of 1996, the company reported earnings of 10.83 million pesos.
Philodrill finance manager Isabelita Matela said the company generated an unexpected gain from the sale of shares in Gotesco Land Inc amounting to 140.537 million pesos.
Philodrill's revenues stood at 161.687 million for the first three quarters of the year while cost and expenses was at 49.025 million pesos.
The company did not give comparative year-ago figures.
